messages:
sam_procurement: FYI HyperLane just confirmed a partial ship for our H200 order. 40/60 units are on the first AWB, the rest delayed ~2–3 weeks. Need to decide: air expedite for the remaining 20 or accept split delivery.

maria_ops: Can you drop the AWB and serial manifest? we need to check depot staging space and customs docs.

logistics_bot: RMA ticket created: HL-RMA-8819. Carrier: SkyFreight. AWB: 1Z9999HL1234, ETA FRA incoming 2026-03-27. Remaining AWB pending.

kevin_hw: If we split, FRA depot cap is tight next wk. Consolidating sea would reduce brokerage but add ~7–10 days. air expedite will hit freight + customs expedite fees. rough extra: +$110–140/unit.

anya_sre: reminder — we also have scheduled cluster maint the same window. If we only get 40, can we reshuffle staging to prioritize critical tenants? who owns the 20 urgent units?

sam_procurement: Callouts: 20 are earmarked for EU self-host customers (priority), 10 for internal capacity, 10 for a beta customer. We should try negotiating with HyperLane for air on the 20 priority units only. request made: can we get per-unit expedite cost + possible credit for late remainder?

maria_ops: We can stage 40 into FRA but need serials to pre-provision tags and warranty link. If air for 20, we want them palletized separately and labeled: PRIORITY-EU.

kevin_hw: Also check HS Code classification — vendor used old HS code and customs flagged the last batch. That caused the delay. if vendor can reissue with HS 847330 (processing units) and updated commercial invoice, we might clear faster.

sam_procurement: HyperLane replied: they can reclassify the delayed pallet and offer air for the 20 priority units at +$95/unit if we accept a consolidated dock-handling surcharge $450. They asked for PO amendment and an immediate partial invoice payment.

anya_sre: +$95 seems reasonable vs lost revenue for customers. but need written SLA for ETA and proof of shipment. ask for AWB and expected arrival window. also request serial batch so our ops can bind to licenses.

maria_ops: If we accept, ops will request temporary loaners for the internal 10 to avoid infra regression. loaners available: LN-1001..LN-1010. we will return after production swap.

sam_procurement: negotiated counter: ask HyperLane to drop surcharge to $250 and keep expedite at $95/unit. Also request partial credit of $3000 for the delayed 20 units. I've emailed them now.

logistics_bot: HyperLane update (automated): Partial invoice for AWB 1Z9999HL1234 sent. Revised commercial invoice attached. New HS code: 847330. Pending payment confirmation.

kevin_hw: Once we have serial manifest we need to run a quick parity check: 40 incoming serials vs manifest. If mismatch, hold at customs and open claims. Please include a checksum column (sha1 of serial+po) in the csv.

maria_ops: dropping CSV here in thread for visibility:
```
serial,po,model,notes
H2-100201,PO-5421,H200,PRIORITY-EU
H2-100202,PO-5421,H200,PRIORITY-EU
H2-100203,PO-5421,H200,PRIORITY-EU
...
```

anya_sre: also add provisioning tags: region=eu-west-1, tenant=alpha, deferred=false. ops will flip license assignment when units show ARRIVED.

sam_procurement: HyperLane accepted counter: surcharge $250, expedite +$95/unit for 20 units, credit $2,500 applied to next invoice. They've asked for payment within 24h to push air manifest. AWB for expedited shipment promised within 6h after payment.

maria_ops: I'm okay to approve payment from ops escrow if finance signs off. Can finance expedite? pinging @kevin_hw for cost approval.

kevin_hw: Approve up to $4,000 out of contingency for expedite + surcharge. Need finance ticket and PO amendment. ops, please hold until I confirm funds moved.

sam_procurement: Filed PO amendment and finance ticket FIN-2026-332. sending vendor payment link now.

logistics_bot: Payment received for expedite. Air AWB issued: 1Z9999HL9999. ETA FRA 2026-03-25 14:30 CET. Tracking: https://skyfreight.example/track/1Z9999HL9999

maria_ops: Great. please ensure pallet label: "PRIORITY-EU - DO NOT CONSOLIDATE". also ops will prepare staging bay 3 for immediate intake.

anya_sre: once arrived, ops run `inventory verify --manifest serials.csv` and then trigger `license bind --batch PRIORITY-EU`. keep me posted on any fails.

kevin_hw: One more ask: if customs re-opens for the remaining 20, we need vendor to supply an indemnity statement. update contract appendix will be required for future.

sam_procurement: noted. adding indemnity clause to vendor LOA. final status: air AWB active for 20 priority, 40 inbound on original AWB, remainder still pending reclass clear. I'll post updates as they come. :thumbsup:
